name: Hanwha AS21 Redback
armament: 30 mm Mk44S Bushmaster II in EOS T-2000 turret
protection: Modular armour, APS provision, rubber tracks. Dimensions approximate. Game rule: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, tracks and exposed crew; penetrating the hull needs launchers (RPG-7 PG-7V, AT4, MAAWS, SMAW, NLAW, Javelin) or cannon.
visual_notes: Large tracked IFV derived from K21
6 road wheels per side with continuous composite rubber tracks
Big angular T-2000 turret with twin Spike launcher box
